_readme: Every business fact on the site comes from this file. Empty values either hide their section or show a visible [placeholder] until filled. Run `python3 build.py` after editing.

services.name: Roof replacement
services.summary: Full tear-off and new roof system: decking checks, underlayment, flashing, ventilation and shingles installed to the manufacturer's specs.

services.name: Roof repair
services.summary: Leaks, missing or lifted shingles, failed flashing and worn pipe boots, found and fixed before they spread.

services.name: Storm and hail damage
services.summary: Inspection after wind and hail, photo documentation, and repairs or replacement once you have a plan.

services.name: Roof inspections
services.summary: A full roof check with photos, for buying or selling a home or just knowing where you stand.

services.name: Metal roofing
services.summary: Standing-seam and exposed-fastener metal roofs for homes, shops and outbuildings.

services.name: Gutters and ventilation
services.summary: Gutters, ridge vents and intake vents so water and heat leave the roof the way they should.

reviews._note: Only real reviews, copied with the customer's permission. Leave empty to show a link to your Google reviews instead.

form._note: Optional: a Formspree (or similar) endpoint. Without it, the form opens an email to business.email.
